answer: Mesa garden admission auction: each epoch the mesa opens 50 garden plots; every identity bids once through the single inlet. Winners lock a 70-credit bond and take a plot. Public bids mean a farm buying many plots pushes its clearing price up: first plot 42, k-th 42+6(k-1). 1,000 fakes cost 3,039,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. The inlet logs each bidder's key, so rented bids sharing a key burn the bond. Honest agents bid 42 once.
